full_details: On the post inside the gate, Longshanks for today at the Rose, and beside it the Theatre's Thursday bill. Black-letter, the title only, no maker's name. A carter told his boy it was a king play on Thursday. At the Theatre Garnish hung the plot and walked the hired men through the lists. Burbage ran the prison alone, twice, for nobody. Nick asked whether the gown shows. It does not. Kemp asked after the sweet tooth, and you did not give him a better answer than the jaw. At noon you conned Gaunt at the window. The afternoon is Errors, and you play Egeon. The journal does not keep the performance. At dusk the memo was thick. Two days. Let it hold till Thursday. Then Yaxley may have it.
one_sentence: A carter named the play before noon, Burbage said the prison speech twice to an empty house, and at dusk you gave the tooth until Thursday.
title: The prison speech twice, and the tooth given two days
